ui.title: AI Coding Free Credits Directory
ui.tagline: Community gateways, free API credits and low-cost plans for Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding tools.
ui.submitTitle: Share your project — Issues are a free promotion space
ui.submitText: Found a useful service, or running one yourself? Open an Issue and include your referral link. Issues are public and can help others discover your project. I may feature particularly useful, verified submissions in the main directory; submission does not guarantee inclusion.
ui.intro: A translated guide to the listed services. Amounts, model IDs, prices and referral URLs are generated from the same data as the Chinese edition. Detailed comparison, history, upstream documentation and some service interfaces remain in Chinese.
ui.planNote: Paid plan, excluded from free-credit totals. These are provider estimates from one shared allowance: do not add model counts or treat them as guaranteed daily/monthly totals.
ui.total: Indicative first-day USD credits: {amount} across {count} services accepting new users.
ui.totalsNote: First-day credit = signup + referral + first check-in (or one daily pool). Credits are separate service balances, not cash. Points, site units, paid plans, archived services and closed registrations are excluded from the USD total. Conditions and actual awards may vary.
ui.dataNote: Credit policies are manually recorded from provider notices; public endpoints do not always expose them. Models, pricing and reachability are refreshed automatically where permitted. Reachability does not prove successful signup or model access.
ui.inviteCode: Referral code — confirm this field before submitting registration
ui.setupNote: Create an API key in the service dashboard and use only a model listed for your account. Anthropic base URLs do not include /v1; OpenAI-compatible URLs usually do. A protocol endpoint does not guarantee access to every model or client.
ui.modelsNote: Only models returned by the public snapshot are listed; missing data does not mean there are no models. Confirm current prices, account groups and availability in the dashboard. Per-request prices are not token prices.
ui.cached: Cached data: the latest probe did not obtain a fresh snapshot. Last successful snapshot: {at}.
ui.blocked: The automated probe was blocked by an anti-bot service. The last successful status is retained; your browser may still work.
steps: Follow the full referral link and check the registration requirements and reward conditions.
Create a key in the dashboard. Use the verified endpoint below, or obtain the current endpoint from the provider if none is public.
Configure a supported client, try a small request and check actual balance consumption before relying on the service.
disclaimer: Links may contain referral codes. Rewards and eligibility are set by each provider; signup alone does not guarantee a reward.
This is an independent directory, not a service operator or a guarantee of uptime. Free offers, prices and policies can change or disappear.
Do not send production secrets, private data or company code to unknown gateways. Use official APIs for important work.
Follow provider and upstream terms. Do not mass-register accounts, abuse promotions or resell credits.
Issue submissions are posted by community members and may be unverified. Assess them independently before registering.
ui.archiveNote: No longer recommended for registration, counted in totals or probed. Original reasons and historical records remain available in the Chinese edition.
ui.maintenanceNote: Edit data/sites.json for shared facts and data/locales/*.json for translated copy, then run npm test and npm run build. README files and HTML pages are generated; do not edit them directly. Report translation errors through Issues.
ui.selectionNote: GitHub does not publish an official ranking of human languages. This project uses the developer-population geography in Octoverse 2025 as a coverage proxy: English, Hindi, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese and German, in addition to existing Chinese. Country is not language; India is multilingual and Hindi does not represent all Indian developers.

artbloom.summary: OpenAI-compatible API service offering $100 in credits on the first day of signup, with Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) listed on its public models page.
artbloom.registration: Use the full referral link and continue with GitHub. The signup page advertises an immediate $100 credit with no credit card required. Create an API key in the dashboard after signing in.
artbloom.notes: The public models page lists Opus 5.5 and other models with their prices. Check the service for current model pricing and the dashboard for your actual balance and usage.

codex-relay.summary: Register with Codex Relay to receive $10 in API credits.
codex-relay.registration: Open the full referral link, keep aff=6jAq and follow the registration instructions. Sign in to view your $10 signup credit balance.
codex-relay.notes: Check the console for available models, prices, API keys, endpoints and client setup instructions.

omnirush.summary: Free GPT 6 Astra, GPT 6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Sol with 50M tokens every week; register through this referral link for an extra 5M tokens.
omnirush.registration: Open the full console referral link, keep ref=AXJFLFPA and follow the signup instructions. Check your weekly allowance and referral reward in the console.
omnirush.notes: The token offer and model list were supplied by a contributor; credited amounts have not been verified while signed in. Check the console for eligibility, reset or rollover rules, bonus frequency and current model access. Tokens are not included in USD totals.

conduit.summary: Register through the Conduit Telegram bot to receive $500 in credits, with GPT-6, Fable 5.1 and other models available.
conduit.registration: Use a Telegram account to open the full referral link, press Start and follow the bot's registration instructions. Keep the referral parameter in the link.
conduit.notes: The signup credit and model information were supplied by a contributor. Check the bot for your actual balance, current models, prices and client setup instructions.

agentrouter.summary: Community gateway with signup, referral and daily check-in credits; Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
agentrouter.registration: Use the referral link with GitHub or LinuxDO. Sign out and sign in again if awarded credits do not appear.
agentrouter.notes: Check in through the dashboard; provider events and referrals may offer more credits. No SLA or top-ups are promised. Request content is restricted to Chinese, English, French, German and Russian: Hindi, Portuguese or Japanese prompts may return HTTP 400. This translated directory does not change that restriction. Bulk accounts, abuse and fake referrals can lead to a ban.

docode.summary: New API gateway with Claude and GPT services; bonuses use internal site units, not US dollars.
docode.registration: Email and password only, with email verification and Cloudflare Turnstile. Confirm referral code {inviteCode} in the signup form before submitting; a missing code cannot be added retroactively. The alternative domain uses the same account and balance.
docode.notes: No daily check-in. Bonuses come from provider notices, not publicly exposed quota fields. Site units must not be added to USD totals: the observed top-up ratio was CNY 1 for 50 units, with a notice also mentioning 25. Group and output multipliers further affect usage. Models and pricing require login. This is a paid gateway after promotional credits run out; upstream outages and price changes are possible.

justdowork.summary: New API gateway with GitHub login, daily check-ins and image/task interfaces.
justdowork.registration: GitHub OAuth only; the GitHub account must be at least 365 days old. Cloudflare Turnstile must load. Keep the full referral URL.
justdowork.notes: Daily rewards are approximate; confirm the actual award in the dashboard. Models and prices require login. Provider notices may include promotional codes. Upstream models, prices and availability can change.

mirasim.summary: Multi-agent workspace with a paid Go plan; connecting your own accounts or API keys is free, but third-party usage is not.
mirasim.registration: Use the full referral link and sign in with GitHub or an email code. No public rule promises a signup bonus to the invitee. Install the official desktop client or follow its CLI documentation; no general-purpose relay base URL has been publicly verified.
mirasim.notes: Go usage estimates share one allowance and cannot be added together. The inviter earns one Go month only after three invited friends all subscribe to Go. Claude/Codex Basic, Pro and Max plans are separate from Go. Alpha software may be slow or interrupted; old beta compensation is not a new-user benefit. Robots rules permit probing the pricing page, not the referral path; online status does not verify signup, payment or inference.

flushapi.summary: New API gateway with GitHub signup, public model pricing and separate default / Super balances.
flushapi.registration: GitHub OAuth only; email/password signup is disabled. No email verification or Turnstile was enabled in the checked configuration. Register through the full referral URL to receive the additional bonus.
flushapi.notes: Signup and referral amounts follow the provider announcement dated 2026-09-24, not public quota fields. The inviter also receives $7.5 per friend according to that notice. Check-in is enabled but no amount was published. Signup credit is in the default balance; flagship Claude/Opus, Fable and GPT models may require the separate Super balance. Check the tier before use. A very new service, with no long-term reliability record; paid top-ups are offered.

kktoken.summary: New API gateway with referral credits, daily check-ins and token-based billing.
kktoken.registration: GitHub OAuth only, with an account at least 365 days old and Cloudflare Turnstile. Use the referral link at signup; the bonus cannot be added later.
kktoken.notes: Credit amounts and the advertised $1 per million input/output tokens are provider notices, not independently verified public pricing. Models and actual prices require login. Check in through the dashboard. This is a paid relay after free credits; anti-bot blocking of automated probes does not necessarily mean the site is down.

matrix.summary: OpenAI-compatible gateway and app store using internal points, with referral and optional identity-verification rewards.
matrix.registration: Use the full invitation URL. Login options include Hangzhou Dianzi University SSO, phone codes, or email/password. Referral rewards are for first-time users and do not require identity verification. Create a mat- key in the dashboard; it is shown once, alongside the current gateway address.
matrix.notes: Points are not USD. Optional identity verification awards 2,000 points once, but requires personal identity information; decide whether that trade-off is worthwhile. The growth campaign is stated to run through 2026-12-31. Gift points only work with eligible services. No native Anthropic endpoint is documented, so Claude Code cannot connect directly. Running app containers keep consuming credit: stop or delete them after use. Paid subscriptions and top-ups are separate.

anyrouter.summary: New API gateway with signup/referral credits, daily check-ins and Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible routes.
anyrouter.registration: Use the referral URL. GitHub accounts must be at least five years old; LinuxDO is an alternative without that stated age requirement. Sign out and back in after check-in to refresh the balance.
anyrouter.notes: Credit amounts and advertised input/output prices of $5/$25 per million tokens come from provider notices. JavaScript challenges prevent automatic public API verification, so confirm models, prices and actual awards in the dashboard. A challenge page is not evidence of an outage.

cheapcodex.summary: AI gateway with referral credits, daily check-ins and OpenAI, Anthropic and Responses routes.
cheapcodex.registration: Email signup only; use the full referral URL because attribution occurs at registration. Third-party OAuth was disabled, and Turnstile was not enabled in the checked configuration.
cheapcodex.notes: Credits and model claims come from provider notices. Robots rules forbid probing the panel API; only /v1/models is checked for reachability, not successful inference. Confirm models and prices after login. Paid subscriptions are separate and checkout may use an external domain. Referral rewards on alternate domains have not been verified.

nofx.summary: Task-based API points with passwordless login, Discord check-ins and referral rewards; points are not USD.
nofx.registration: Keep the full referral URL. Sign in through an email magic link or GitHub. Join Discord and select /verify and /checkin from the command menu; those rewards cannot be claimed without Discord. Get the API key and actual base URL from the authenticated dashboard.
nofx.notes: Points expire after 30 days; real API usage resets that period. Check-ins pause above a 50-point balance. Discord verification gives 5 points once (code valid for 30 minutes), referrals give 5 points per friend, and an approved X post gives 20 points once. The landing page advertises 20 signup points while the recorded referral rule gives 10: verify the actual award. No public points-to-USD conversion exists. Robots rules only permit checking public pages; models and prices require login.

novai.summary: Zero-fee gateway for 121 Chinese frontier models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
novai.registration: Sign up free for $2 credit (no card); five models are free and unlimited.
novai.notes: 0% platform markup; live pricing at /china-ai-leaderboard.json; image models carry a visible AI watermark per China rules.
